props.counter_en: Traditionally neutralised only by another Brahmastra, or by withdrawal
props.symbolic_meaning_en: The destructive potential of knowledge without restraint

short_description.en: The astra presided over by Brahma, invoked by mantra and described in the epics as irresistible once released.
short_description.hi: ब्रह्मा द्वारा अधिष्ठित अस्त्र, जो मंत्र से आह्वान किया जाता है और महाकाव्यों में छूटने के बाद अनिवार्य बताया गया है।

verification.notes: Withdrawal episode cross-checked in Sauptika Parva.
